subject: Intro call follow-up: economic buyer & procurement steps - Skyline Analytics
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@skyline-analytics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro call - Skyline Analytics & Redwood Inference

Hi Jordan - great to meet today, thanks for walking through your use case. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can keep momentum: 

- Recap: your team wants to run near-real-time summarization + classification over incoming event streams (high throughput, variable sequence lengths). Current stack: in-house inference for prototypes; production needs are reliability and cost predictability.
- Success criteria you mentioned: sub-200ms 95th latency for short requests, predictable per-token cost, and SLA for peak windows.

Action items / next steps:
1) Can you confirm who owns budget approvals for this initiative (economic buyer)?
2) Who handles procurement/contract reviews on your side (legal or procurement contact)?
3) I attached a short mutual action plan template and our one-pager to share with your stakeholders - happy to tailor it.

If you can intro the economic buyer and procurement contact, we'll prepare a brief exec summary and draft MAP tailored to their priorities. Proposed next meeting: 30-min alignment with the buying team next week.

Thanks - I'll follow up with a draft MAP after this note.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0123
Attachment: Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
Attachment: Redwood_OnePager.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@skyline-analytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Feb 2027 09:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro call - Skyline Analytics & Redwood Inference

Hi Marissa - appreciate the recap. Sounds right. A couple clarifications: 

- Economic buyer: Priya Desai, VP Finance (priya.desai@skyline-analytics.com). Priya will sign off on budget and capex.
- Procurement / legal: Samir Patel (samir.patel@skyline-analytics.com) owns the procurement queue and contracts. He'll want our standard security questionnaire answered and an initial SOW/estimate.

I'll make an intro to Priya + Samir and copy you. Quick note - Priya is focused on total cost of ownership and vendor reliability; Samir will push for SOC2 evidence and standard indemnities.

-Jordan
Senior Engineering Manager | Skyline Analytics
jordan.lee@skyline-analytics.com

Subject: Fwd: Intro call - Skyline Analytics & Redwood Inference (stakeholder mapping)

Team - forwarding Jordan's reply. He confirmed Priya (economic buyer) and Samir (procurement). Draft stakeholder map below: 

- Jordan Lee - Technical champion, evaluating latency/cost tradeoffs, wants a POC with 2 weeks of traffic.
- Priya Desai - Economic buyer (VP Finance) - primary sign off for budget; cares about TCO and contract terms.
- Samir Patel - Procurement / Legal - will run questionnaire, needs SOC2/attestation and standard contract redlines.
- Internal: me (AE) + Rishi (Sales Lead) + Vivek (SE) for technical + procurement conversations.

Planned next steps:
1) Rishi & I will draft a short exec summary for Priya focused on TCO, ROI, and mitigations for vendor risk.
2) Vivek to prepare a one-slide latency/cost summary for the execs (95th percentile numbers + options for quantized models).
3) We'll send the MAP + filled procurement questionnaire to Samir and ask for a timeline for legal review.

I've attached the MAP and our one-pager - please review and suggest edits. I'll draft the outreach to Priya once we align.

Thanks - Marissa

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Desai <priya.desai@skyline-analytics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@skyline-analytics.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Feb 2027 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Intro + brief exec summary - Redwood Inference & Skyline Analytics

Hi Priya - Jordan suggested I reach out with a short executive summary and proposed next steps for procurement. Briefly: Redwood Inference is a developer-first LLM inference platform focused on production reliability and predictable unit economics. For Skyline's summarization use case we estimate: 

- Target: sub-200ms 95th latency (short requests) with a dedicated deployment profile.
- Cost framing: expected TCO reduction vs. in-house prototype when considering autoscaling, batching, and KV caching - we'll quantify in the exec summary.

Attachments included: a one-pager (high-level value props), a mutual action plan (proposed milestones & owners), and a filled procurement questionnaire to expedite legal review. Key asks from your side: 
1) Confirmation of budget owner and approval timeline.
2) Point of contact for procurement/legal review (Samir was recommended by Jordan).
3) Availability for a 30-min alignment with you + Samir next week - we'll keep it concise: ROI, T&Cs, and a proposed timeline for a short POC.

If helpful I can share an anonymized reference (customer in your vertical) who had a similar evaluation and measurable cost reduction - happy to add that to the packet.

Thanks for taking a look - I'll follow up in 48 hours if I haven't heard back.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0123
